name: Cirrus — Cloud Dev Environments
description: A pixel-matrix landing page for Cirrus, cloud development environments: white paper under a faint 9px grid, big grotesk type and a navy, cobalt, gold, red and lime palette that only ever appears as squares — a hero of drifting diagonal pixel weather that erodes as you scroll, headlines that type themselves in, photographs that bleed in through fog, two particle-stream diagrams of how it works, hairline pricing and FAQ, a pixel-text marquee and a playable Tetris skyline for a footer.
designedFor: Developer tools, cloud platforms and infrastructure products
Editorial, argument-led product pages with long reading sections
Pages that want generative pixel art instead of stock illustration
Seeing canvas animations built as editor-controllable components the Motion switch can stop
